text: Germany's army just grounded its recon drones.
Hackers broke into Quantum Systems, a seven billion euro drone maker, and hid malware in a routine software update.
The fake update reached army servers. Not the drones.
The army grounded them anyway. They even sat out a military exercise.
They're flying again now. But one poisoned update can reach every customer at once.
So the next time an update pops up on your phone, remember.
